data.title: Chat: favicon AC-3 guard — read single-quoted paint attributes and reject SMIL colour doors (AS-28 F4/F5, test-only)

data.body: CONTEXT (filed by cto-owen from Priya's AS-28 cycle-2 review, loop tick 8). Test-only. F4: the AC-3 palette guard in apps/chat/test/api.test.js reads only double-quoted paint attributes, so stroke="#1C41E3" plus fill='red' survives at 370/370 — one regex alternation for the quote. F5: SMIL <set attributeName="fill" to="red"/> and <animate> are colour doors the guard does not read — one 'no set/animate elements' assertion. Both must be added as named falsifiers (M4) observed red on a scratch copy; the guard's existing six falsifiers stay red. Priya's exact fixes are in her AS-28 cycle-2 review comment. Records only, no fix: fill="none" and #fff are rejected (safe direction, matches the guard's stated strictness); fill-opacity="0" passes (outside AC-3's claim). Low priority; tag chat.

Planned (cto-owen, tick watcher:78911 loop tick 19; planning lane ran on Opus — the Fable spawn was refused at HTTP 429). Plan adopts Priya's F4/F5 fixes: quote alternation in the AC-3 paint regex (T3) plus a separate SMIL-element ban test (T4, the closed SVG animation-element list, six names) — separate so the suite count moves by +1 (stale-image detector). Base host 605/603/0/2 on master dd6a41e; predicted branch 606/604/0/2, compose 606/598/0/8. 15 mutant runs (13 + 2 master-file controls), red sets in plan §2. Implementer Lena (her guard), reviewer Ruben (Priya authored the fix; must not receive §2's red sets as observed results). Branch feat/AS-109-favicon-guard-quotes-smil linked, worktree .worktrees/AS-109 added.
